supply_reconciliation.note: The official October 29 figure is an issuer-disclosed total supply/reserve snapshot. Coindaro's October 30 chain-specific changes are sourced analytics. Q-Eternal's later two-chain values are reported ledger queries. They are not identical timestamps or identical measurement methods; the derived difference is a reconciliation lead, not proof of cash redemption or reserve outflow.

important_interpretation_controls: RLUSD is a separate USD-denominated token, not XRP. A fall in RLUSD supply does not mechanically imply XRP selling or buying.
Tokens returned to the issuer reduce outstanding on-chain supply; this does not by itself prove an equivalent USD redemption, cash leaving reserve accounts, or a customer cash-out.
An increase in Ethereum supply during the same window does not prove the XRPL tokens were bridged or migrated. Separate mint/burn events can produce similar aggregate changes.
The month-end pattern is a candidate operational/treasury explanation, not a confirmed Ripple policy. Ripple has not publicly explained the October 30 contraction in the cited sources.
The October contraction is unusually large in dollar terms relative to prior reported months and merits issuer-wallet transaction replay.
The undated 852.4M XRPL.to page value is preserved as a data-quality conflict, not used to overwrite the pinned 711.8M ledger observation.
The official October 29 reserve report predates the October 30 contraction and cannot be used as a post-event attestation.
